name: +1 Skate Trickz Escape
creator: +1 Skateboard Trickz
redeem: Launch +1 Skate Trickz Escape and wait for the on-screen buttons to appear.
Click the Codes button on the left side of the screen.
Type or paste the code into the Enter code here... box.
Click the Redeem button under the box to claim the reward.
notes:
+1 Skate Trickz Escape is a skateboarding progression game released in August 2026 by the Roblox group +1 Skateboard Trickz. Your board keeps gaining jump power and speed, which you use to launch higher, pull off tricks, and climb toward the heaven area at the top of the map. Jumps and speed keep building while you are offline, so returning players pick up where the counter left off, and a later update added races with their own reward currency.

Codes give Wins and Race Points, which feed straight into more jump power, speed, and cosmetic flair. The developers have so far tied codes to milestones such as total plays and concurrent players, and share them in the game description, their Roblox group, and their Discord server.
